integrity: The published symmetric-Minkowski reduction was inspected in the full defining source. After that reduction, all octagonal norm branches, breakpoints, derivative signs, and the sharp pair are checked exactly in Q(sqrt(2)). Finite grid checks are supplementary only. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes the fixed Liu–Yang–Fu–Li Omega constant only for the regular octagonal plane. It does not provide a formula for all regular polygons or classify every maximizing pair beyond the reduced parameter ratios.
title: Exact isosceles-orthogonal \(\Omega\)-constant of the regular octagonal Banach plane
